rounds.q: What % of the world lives on less than $3 a day?
rounds.why: That's about 824 million people. Most regions are now below 5%.
rounds.src: World Bank, September 2026 Global Poverty Update (2024 data)
rounds.fun: About 824 million people live on under $3 a day, but most regions are now below 5%.

rounds.q: What % of the world lives on less than $8.30 a day?
rounds.why: As recently as 2000, about 71% of humanity lived below that same line.
rounds.src: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform via Our World in Data (2024)
rounds.fun: From about 71% in 2000 to 46% now. That's a lot of people climbing the ladder!

rounds.q: What % of adults worldwide have a bank or mobile money account?
rounds.why: That still leaves 1.3 billion adults with no account at all.
rounds.src: World Bank, Global Findex Database 2025 (2024 data)
rounds.fun: 79% of adults have an account. Piggy banks have gone high tech!

rounds.q: What % of adults in sub-Saharan Africa have a mobile money account?
rounds.why: Just three years earlier, in 2021, it was only 27%.
rounds.src: World Bank, Global Findex Database 2025 (2024 data)
rounds.fun: From 27% to 40% in just three years. Mobile money is on the move!

rounds.q: Send $200 to family in another country. What % goes to fees?
rounds.why: Sending money to sub-Saharan Africa costs the most, about 8.5% of the amount.
rounds.fun: Send $200 and about $12 goes to fees. Ouch, that's a lot of snack money!
